name: intelmcp
description: Threat intelligence from Telegram (public channels, and private channels and groups the operator has reviewed), searchable and monitored inside Claude. Includes a setup interview (/intelmcp:setup), a dashboard (/intelmcp:dashboard), match triage (/intelmcp:triage), investigations (/intelmcp:investigate) and your own live command centre page (/intelmcp:command-centre). Requires an IntelMCP subscription from intelmcp.io.
